audience: sales and service teams that keep their customer records in Spotler CRM

useCases.title: Find open opportunities and their owners
useCases.text: List opportunities with a JSON filter and order. Open one opportunity with its line items, then ask which deals have been open for more than 90 days.

useCases.title: Look up contacts and accounts
useCases.text: List contacts or accounts with a filter and paging. Open one record by its type and id to read its fields.

useCases.title: Check required fields and dropdown values
useCases.text: Read the fields of a record type and see which ones are required. List the dropdown values, such as account types, before you enter data.

useCases.title: Create or update a CRM record
useCases.text: Read the data dictionary first. Then create a record or update the fields of one existing record. The write changes live CRM data.
